rca_of_issues.T2_react_418: ConsentBanner.jsx uses useEffect to add 'consent-banner-open' class to document.body when consent has not been chosen. On cold load, hasConsentChoice() returns false → show=true → body class added immediately on first React render cycle. The prerendered HTML (from static build) has no body class. When React hydrates and checks the DOM, the body className differs → hydration mismatch → React error #418. Fix: suppress class during SSR by using a useIsomorphicLayoutEffect or delaying body mutation until after hydration (e.g., useEffect with a setTimeout(0) or checking typeof window). CR-93 added this feature without accounting for SSR/hydration.
rca_of_issues.T6_dead_routes: Build dirs for bars-pubs and hotels-resorts exist but the URL slugs used in navigation (/solutions/bars-and-pubs, /solutions/hotels) have no corresponding build dirs or _redirects entries. The SPA fallback rule (/* /index.html 200) catches these and serves the React app at the homepage route, causing the browser to display homepage content at a different URL — duplicate content for SEO crawlers.
